evidence: Matches the Utils/log/libs label and modifies BCLog::LogEscapeMessage in src/logging.cpp.
rationale: Prevents terminal manipulation from untrusted log output by escaping UTF-8 C1 control characters. LogEscapeMessage currently allows two-byte sequences (0xC2 0x80 to 0xC2 0x9F) that VTE-based terminal emulators interpret as control codes such as CSI, OSC, and DCS.
